recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片紅血球密集重疊、幾乎沒有空隙，反映紅血球增多；骨髓抹片與切片細胞量符合年齡、紅系與巨核細胞形態正常，沒有真性紅血球增多症常見的三系增生與多形性巨核細胞，支持先天性（Chuvash）紅血球增多症。
features: Peripheral blood with tightly packed, overlapping red cells (increased RBC density) and few platelets (A)
Occasional neutrophil and platelet clumps without leukoerythroblastic features (A)
Aspirate particle of normal cellularity at low power (B)
Aspirate with maturing erythroid precursors, mature lymphocytes and a few neutrophils; no dysplasia (C)
Normocellular trephine with preserved fat and normal-appearing megakaryocytes without clustering (D)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed overlapping red cells, reflecting erythrocytosis, with relatively few platelets. The bone marrow aspirate is normocellular with adequate erythroid precursors showing normal maturation and no dysplastic features. The trephine biopsy is normocellular for age with preserved fat and megakaryocytes of normal size and distribution, without clustering or pleomorphism. The absence of panmyelosis and megakaryocytic atypia argues against polycythemia vera; findings are consistent with a secondary or congenital erythrocytosis, such as Chuvash polycythemia, in the appropriate molecular context.

ddx.vs: PV shows a hypercellular marrow with panmyelosis and pleomorphic, clustered megakaryocytes, low serum EPO and a JAK2 mutation, unlike this normocellular marrow.
Marrow morphology is similar; distinction relies on elevated EPO with an identified acquired cause rather than a germline VHL variant.

ddx.dx: Primary familial and congenital polycythemia (EPOR mutation)
ddx.vs: EPOR mutation causes low serum EPO, whereas VHL/Chuvash polycythemia shows normal to elevated EPO; morphology cannot separate them.
Detected by a low P50 on oxygen dissociation testing and hemoglobin analysis, not by marrow morphology.
